title: shawk / Dependency map
description: Dependency map from PostgreSQL around the selected services.

list.query: SELECT id FROM shawk_v1.graph_nodes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY id
list.definition: SELECT id FROM shawk_v1.graph_nodes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY id

panels.title: Dependencies of $service

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE e AS (
  SELECT id, source, target, mainstat, first_seen, last_seen
  FROM shawk_v1.graph_edges_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
),
walk (node, depth) AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY[${service:singlequote}]::text[]), 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.source = w.node THEN e.target ELSE e.source END, w.depth + 1
  FROM walk w
  JOIN e ON ('$direction' IN ('downstream', 'both') AND e.source = w.node)
         OR ('$direction' IN ('upstream', 'both') AND e.target = w.node)
  WHERE w.depth < $depth
) CYCLE node SET is_cycle USING path,
reached AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM walk)

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.subtitle, n.mainstat || ' hosts' AS mainstat
FROM shawk_v1.graph_nodes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) n
WHERE n.id IN (SELECT node FROM reached)

),
walk (node, depth) AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.source = w.node THEN e.target ELSE e.source END, w.depth + 1
  FROM walk w
  JOIN e ON ('$direction' IN ('downstream', 'both') AND e.source = w.node)
         OR ('$direction' IN ('upstream', 'both') AND e.target = w.node)

) CYCLE node SET is_cycle USING path,
reached AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM walk)

SELECT e.id, e.source, e.target, e.mainstat, e.last_seen AS secondarystat
FROM e
WHERE e.source IN (SELECT node FROM reached) AND e.target IN (SELECT node FROM reached)

panels.description: Services reached from the selected services within the depth, in the time range. A peer without a known service is shown by its address.

),
walk (node, depth) AS (

  FROM walk w
  JOIN e ON ('$direction' IN ('downstream', 'both') AND e.source = w.node)

reached AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM walk)

    SELECT e.source AS client, e.target AS server, e.mainstat AS ports, e.first_seen, e.last_seen
    FROM e
    WHERE e.source IN (SELECT node FROM reached) AND e.target IN (SELECT node FROM reached)
    ORDER BY e.last_seen DESC
